title: Batch B floor-to-ceiling package runs reach frontier probes but fail to preserve direct target truth into final findings or verification
symptom: The full Batch B floor-to-ceiling campaign on 2026-04-07 reached frontier target probes for config, reporting, and pricing, but final findings or verification still regressed on CFG_OpenLicensedWindow, CFG_RunCustomerSync, RP_SelectFormat, PR_ApplyBundleOverride, and PR_BeginQuote.
smallest_reproducer: Campaign 8e9a12f9 reduced-frontier rerun on 2026-04-07 with active frontier contoso_config.dll, contoso_reporting.dll, and contoso_pricing.dll under floor_to_ceiling mode; inspect 88d563b7, 800ce1a1, and 5648f889 plus campaign-attribution-report.json regression_summary.
trust_impact: Package-scale confirmation is not promotion-safe because direct target success and verification truth can be lost after the right frontier function is reached, leaving overlap regressions that are not DLL-behavior regressions.
allowed_next_actions: inspect direct probe to finding persistence for CFG_OpenLicensedWindow and RP_SelectFormat
inspect direct probe to verification persistence for CFG_RunCustomerSync and PR_ApplyBundleOverride
audit why PR_BeginQuote remains unexplained despite package verification being present
run one narrow same-DLL reproducer per affected frontier function after code changes
disallowed_next_actions: another blind full Batch B rerun without fixing persistence
promotion of the current campaign as a stable baseline
exit_criteria: direct target probe success is preserved into final finding status when present
verification-report entries exist for frontier targets that reach direct probe surfaces
